title: Separate the variables
text: Separate to get $$\frac{dy}{a y+b}=dx$$. The left side integrates to $$\frac{1}{a}\ln|ay+b|$$

title: Solve and use the initial condition
text: So $$a y+b=A e^{a x}$$, and at $$x=0$$ we get $$A=a c+b$$. Dividing by $$a$$ gives $$y=\left(c+\frac{b}{a}\right) e^{a x}-\frac{b}{a}$$.
